# Code review: session-expiry toast only on workspace routes

Mode: committed range, read-only, run manually. I did the nine checks myself instead of with one agent per area, and ran no tests.
2 files, +58 −16 · base `913ee53` (merge-base of `facc006`) → `e65f0da` (2 commits).
Next.js web app · TypeScript · Jest · checked against `AGENTS.md` and `apps/web/AGENTS.md`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | OK to open the PR after fixing F1, or after confirming that leaving onboarding out is intended |
| **Score** | ~88 / 100 (only 1 of 4 findings was checked by both agents) |
| **Held down by** | Workspace onboarding routes get no toast (F1) |
| **Fix first** | F1 |

## Scores by area

| Area | Score | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Bugs | 85 | F1 |
| Testing | 90 | F3 |
| DRY | 92 | F2 |
| KISS | 96 | F4 |
| Security, regression, architecture, performance, conventions | 100 | nothing found |

Regression: `SESSION_EXPIRED_SIGN_IN_LABEL` was removed, and no other code, e2e test or Cypress test uses it or the "Sign in to workspaces" text. Conventions: the UI copy is in sentence case and the comments are sparse and useful.

## Must fix before opening

**F1 · P2 · Bugs · CONFIRMED (validator and refuter agree, confidence 90)**
`apps/web/src/services/sessionExpiry/useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:22-23`

- **What:** `isSpacesRoute` only matches `/welcome/spaces`, `/spaces` and `/spaces/*`. It leaves out the signed-in workspace onboarding routes `/welcome/create-space`, `/welcome/select-safes`, `/welcome/invite-members` and `/welcome/survey` (`apps/web/src/config/routes.ts:83-87`).
- **What happens:** a user creating a workspace hits expiry, and `expireNow()` clears auth without a toast. `useFlowActivationGuard` (`apps/web/src/hooks/useRouterGuard/activationGuards/useFlowActivationGuard.ts:18-22, 40-47`) then redirects them off the page. That redirect happens after `pathnameRef` has already been read, so it cannot bring the toast back. The redirect can also land on `/welcome/accounts`. The user is thrown out of onboarding with no explanation.
- **Fix:** include the onboarding routes in the match. You could share the `ONBOARDING_ROUTES` list from `useFlowActivationGuard.ts:18` rather than copy it. If leaving them out is deliberate, say so in the doc comment at `:46`.

## Worth a ticket or your call (not checked by the agents)

| ID | Pri | Area | Where | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F2 | P3 | DRY | `useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:22` | `apps/web/src/hooks/useIsSpaceRoute.ts:6-26` already decides what counts as a workspace route, and the new check disagrees with it. It adds `/welcome/spaces`, `/spaces/create-space` and `/spaces/transactions`, and it ignores `lastUsedSpace`. The hook can't be called inside a timer callback, but its route lists could be exported so both use one source. |
| F3 | P3 | Testing | `__tests__/useSessionExpiryGuard.test.tsx:316-341` | No test covers a nested route like `/spaces/members`, which is the only thing that exercises the `startsWith('/spaces/')` branch. There is also no test that navigates between arming the timer and the timer firing, which is why the pathname is kept in a ref. The 403 probe path outside workspaces is also untested. Deleting the `startsWith` branch or the ref update would still pass every test. |
| F4 | P3 | KISS / UX | `useSessionExpiryGuard.ts:84` | With `autoHideDuration: null`, a toast raised on `/spaces` stays up after the user moves to `/home`, until they dismiss it or sign in again. That partly contradicts the "only in workspaces" goal. |

## Not covered by this review

- Only F1 went through the two-agent check. F2–F4 are my own reading and still count fully in the score.
- I didn't look at Safe pages opened from inside a workspace, such as `/home` with the workspaces sidebar (`SafeSidebarVariant`). Whether they should show the toast is a product decision.
- I ran no tests, type-check or lint, and used no symbol-aware search tool. I found who uses the removed label with grep.
- No clean-up suggestions: the change is small, and F2 already covers the only one worth making.

Nothing was posted or changed.
